correctness.rationale: The exact object is the line-avoiding simplicial complex on 15 nonzero vectors of F_2^4, with 35 line obstructions and 3048 nonempty faces. A GL_4(F_2) matrix is determined uniquely by an ordered independent 4-tuple, giving 20160 matrices. For any g the fixed nonempty simplices are precisely unions of admissible point-permutation cycles; orientation sign times simplicial Lefschetz sign reduces to -sum_{admissible cycle subsets J} (-1)^|J|, including the augmented empty term. Independent exhaustive computation rebuilt all 35 lines, all faces and all matrices and obtained exactly 12 (order, trace, count) profiles [(1,77,1),(2,-3,105),(2,5,210),(3,-1,112),(3,2,1120),(4,-3,1260),(4,1,2520),(5,2,1344),(6,-1,1680),(6,0,3360),(7,0,5760),(15,-1,2688)]. Their counts sum to 20160 and weighted traces to 0. The published integral Moore-space theorem provides the indispensable premise that only rational H4 survives, of dimension 77; the Lefschetz trace alone would otherwise be merely an alternating sum. Rational transfer after equivariant barycentric subdivision identifies quotient homology with invariants; the quotient claim is rational acyclicity, not contractibility or integral acyclicity.
